attchmntText: GTL Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication pertaining to financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: GTL Infrastructure Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 6, 2026. Total income from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 33,514 Lakhs. Net profit after tax for the quarter was 26,291 Lakhs. Earnings per share for the quarter was 0.20. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, total income from operations was 66,751 Lakhs. Net profit after tax for the half year was 33,230 Lakhs. Earnings per share for the half year was 0.25. The advertisements were published in The Free Press Journal and Navshakti on November 7, 2026. The results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: GTL Infrastructure Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
